name: "Spirit Garden" Guacamole Board with Cotija Cheese, Pomegranate, Pumpkin Seeds & Blue Corn Chips

instructions.primary_message: For a kid-friendly version of this delicious dip, decrease the jalapeño, cilantro, onion, and garlic as desired (or omit altogether!).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 jalapeño pepper
¼ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a medium bowl.

Halve and pit avocados. Scoop out the flesh and add to the bowl with the lime juice. Add salt, then mash with a potato masher or fork until smooth. (Chef's Tip: for an extra creamy texture, beat the avocado with a wire whisk after it has been mashed.)

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the mashed avocado. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, halve, and mince onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ medium white onion
2 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems. Set a small handful of small leaves aside for "the garden," then mince remaining leaves. Add minced cilantro to the bowl and stir to combine the guacamole.
Scoop the guacamole out onto a serving dish or board. Using the back of a spoon, spread the guacamole out in an even layer, leaving a 1-inch border around the edge of the dish.
Crumble Cotija cheese over the guacamole, then sprinkle with reserved cilantro leaves, pumpkin seeds, and pomegranate seeds.
instructions.secondary_message:
28 g Cotija cheese
3 tbsp pumpkin seeds
3 tbsp pomegranate seeds

instructions.primary_message: Decorate the "spirit garden" guacamole board with a handful of chips, pressing the tip of each chip into the guacamole to resemble a "spirit" rising from the garden. Serve with remaining chips on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
